scope.training: Program.fit, fit_if, VJP and distributed/partitioned training replay the original graph. No training speedup is attributable to these passes.
scope.specialized_models: Sequential.model_*, CausalLM, Samba and specialized block APIs do not call program_optimize. A faithful qualified captured Program adapter is required before their saved workloads become affected optimizer recipes. An opaque composite op does not expose its internal graph to these passes.
scope.excluded_estimators: Classical/tree/nearest-neighbor boards do not capture OpsProgram and are not affected by these five passes.
scope.claims: No pass has full-workload NVIDIA/AMD A/B evidence here; no default change or performance claim. Prepared synthetic full declared workloads are not substitutes for missing real-model coverage.

passes.name: explicit_reshape_chain
passes.effect: Compose adjacent explicit positive-dimension reshapes while preserving shape validators.
passes.activation_gate: Persist inspect(optimize=True); require a positive named rewrite count in the actual exported/captured workload. Existing simple MLP has no view chain.
passes.measurement_group: all-off versus all-on; reshapes interact with dead_intermediates

passes.name: permutation_composition
passes.effect: Compose adjacent supported permutation/transpose nodes, retaining rank/axis validation.
passes.activation_gate: Actual attention layout capture must contain adjacent eligible permutations; using an opaque transformer op does not establish activation.
passes.measurement_group: all-off versus all-on; permutations interact with dead_intermediates

passes.name: dead_intermediates
passes.effect: Remove newly redundant view intermediates produced by preceding view rewrites, not arbitrary graph dead code.
passes.activation_gate: Record removed source-node IDs and dependencies on successful reshape/permutation rewrites.
passes.measurement_group: dependent view/pruning combination; standalone pruning attribution is not currently available

passes.name: broadcast_relu_hoist
passes.effect: Move ReLU before an adjacent single-consumer, non-output expansion with a statically proven smaller source.
passes.activation_gate: No saved full model with a demonstrated eligible expand->ReLU path has been identified. Fused linear-ReLU MLP and SiLU/GELU Transformer paths do not demonstrate this pass. Dynamic inputs alone do not prove source shape.
passes.missing_recipe: Retain a real user/imported supported model, full inputs and source provenance that naturally contains this pattern. Artificial redundant broadcasts are screening only.
passes.measurement_group: all-off versus all-on after an actual full workload exists

passes.name: exact_duplicate_elimination
passes.effect: Reuse exactly matching safe pure nodes under the captured immutable parameter/input contract.
passes.activation_gate: Actual capture must contain eligible duplicate nodes. A hand-shared DAG or opaque composite may yield zero hits; do not inject duplicate work into the baseline to manufacture a gain.
passes.measurement_group: all-off versus all-on including interactions with view rewrites and ReLU hoist

campaign.freeze: Freeze one source commit, source bytes, compiler version, flags and target. Reuse accepted binaries when complete native closure matches; parent alone compiles changed closures on cheap build hosts. Do not rebuild unchanged controls.
campaign.devices: Owned NVIDIA and AMD physical GPUs; one serial cell at a time per GPU, vendors may run in parallel. No rentals authorized by this plan. Apple same-version identity is required but its timing does not vote.
campaign.samples: One excluded warmup and one scored sample per arm/cell for the initial full-workload screen. Retain every raw time, actual samples and failures; this is not a statistical confidence claim. Measure paired baseline noise separately before promotion.
campaign.identity: Baseline versus candidate complete output/state bytes must match on each device, and Apple/NVIDIA/AMD outputs must match within this version. Preserve full returned data or content-hashed retained bytes plus exact model/input artifacts. Do not replace cross-vendor identity with a separate Apple reference.
campaign.quality: Record full-dataset loss/accuracy or task metrics as applicable; reject own candidate quality regressions. Opponent quality is displayed, not an admission gate. This own-only A/B does not rerace or invent opponent scores.
campaign.promotion: Use the existing joint NVIDIA/AMD ratio/noise policy and flag vendor splits. Require every affected full workload and relevant combined configuration, accepted identity and quality. Keep default optimize=False until evidence qualifies a concrete change.
campaign.retention: Save source/binary/input/checkpoint bytes, installed-package and hardware manifests, effective settings, inspect reports, whole-operation timing records, outputs and complete failures on Mac and R2 as cells land. Use tools/bench_board_evidence.py and board tools; preserve original failed records. Do not tear down before actual bytes are retained.
campaign.publication: Internal plan only. No public support/performance statements and no board completion claims from this mapping.
